授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Course Description
Mitochondria have long been recognized as organelles responsible for energy production. However, recent advances in understanding the mechanisms that maintain mitochondrial function and the pathogenesis associated with their dysfunction have revealed that mitochondria also function as dynamic platforms regulating a wide range of cellular processes beyond metabolism.
This lecture aims to introduce emerging concepts in mitochondrial biology and disease, focusing on their relationship with iron, an essential metal for life. Through this perspective, participants will deepen their understanding of current developments in mitochondrial research.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: This course is primarily intended for postgraduate students. Fourth-year undergraduate students are also welcome to attend. Please note that lectures scheduled for undergraduate students will proceed as planned and will not be cancelled.
